image_description: A close-up photograph of a male Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a textured tree branch. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, white belly, and black wings featuring distinct white bars. The background is a soft, out-of-focus bokeh of blue sky and branches.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alikes like Chaffinch or Bullfinch.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, edge bleeding, or unnatural bokeh patterns common in AI generations.
To verify the physical connection between toes and branch, ensuring no floating limbs or merging geometry.

focus_areas: Feet-to-branch contact points for structural integrity
Transition zones between black head and orange breast for color bleeding
White wing bar definition against black feathers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the feet. AI often struggles with the complex geometry of bird toes gripping a branch. Verify if the toes wrap around logically or if they appear fused/melted into the wood. Also check the eye reflection; it should be consistent with the lighting direction implied by the shadows on the body.
